title: GPUI Archipelago Manifest
description: A manifest of projects shipped downstream of GPUI islands: forks, apps, libraries, tooling, and learning material. Not limited to cargo crates.

subcategory.description: Category-specific grouping; today used for Apps (Developer Tools, Productivity, Media, System Utilities, Demos & Examples).

url.description: Home page, repository, or other canonical link.

image.description: Optional icon or screenshot shown next to the project name.

crateStatus.description: Crate publish status (Forks category); drives the badge in both tables.

crateUrl.description: crates.io page for the fork's crate, when one exists.

tag.description: Optional small label pill next to the name, e.g. "upstream mirror".

footnote.description: Shows a footnote marker in the forks at a glance table.

description.description: One or two sentences. Inline links may be written as [text](url).
